features_section.label: Key features
features_section.title: Everything you need to manage your events
features_section.description: Discover how our software can simplify your daily management and improve your team's productivity.
features_section.privacy_description: Your data is yours. Everything is stored locally in .gep files. Work without internet connection and without relying on cloud servers.
features_section.team_management_description: Assign technical and artistic staff safely. The system automatically alerts you if you try to assign someone who is already busy at another event.
features_section.tech_sheets_description: Generate professional technical documentation (PDF) in seconds. Includes schedules, technical needs (sound, lights), logistics and contacts automatically.
features_section.inventory_description: Analyze the real availability of your material. The system calculates the daily demand peak to ensure you have enough stock for all simultaneous events.
features_section.google_integration_description: Manage dedicated calendars for the app and view your personal agenda. Note: This feature requires manual authorization. Contact the developer to enable your Google account.

download_section.label: Download now
download_section.title: Available on all platforms
download_section.description: Choose your platform and start managing your events today. Fast, secure and easy to use.
download_section.version_info_description: The Android version is a reduced version of the desktop application, designed for quick consultation and basic event management.
download_section.limitations_title: Main limitations of the Android version:
download_section.limitation_1: Does not include all advanced features of the desktop version
download_section.limitation_2: Optimized for mobile use with a simplified interface
download_section.recommendation: For professional use with all features, we recommend using the desktop version (Windows, macOS or Linux).
